QuestInfo.name: The Miracle of Life 1
QuestInfo.0: Kumo was an expert at hatching eggs, but for some reason he was pacing around nervously. Alpha and Beta decided to give him a hand.
QuestInfo.1: A strange egg was found in the Minar Forest. It may die since it was left alone so long and it's temperature has gone down. Go get #r#t4000906##k to be used for firewood and #r#t4000909##k to wrap the egg up.
QuestInfo.2: You were able to save the egg by starting a fire with beetle's horn and by wrapping the egg in #t4000909#.

0.0: Hey, you! Come and help me! I found this egg in Minar Forest, but it's been outside for too long. It's going to freeze! Bring me something to keep it warm!

yes.0: We need to build a fire, but all the branches are wet! Get #r8 #t4000906##k items instead! And get #r8 #t4000909##k items so we can bundle up the egg. Hurry! Hurry!
I'll use the #t4000906# to start a fire. Can you bundle the egg in the #t4000909#? \r\n\r\n

item.0: We need to get the egg's temperature up or it's doomed! Where are the #r8 #t4000906##k and #r8 #t4000909##k items?
